title: ComposioProxy
description: supabase/functions/composio-proxy/index.ts. A transparent path-forwarding proxy for the Composio API, called server-to-server from the AgentService Node sidecar (not directly from the Swift/C# client) via the Composio SDK's baseURL option — the SDK builds request URLs by concatenating baseURL + its own internal paths, so this proxy strips its own /composio-proxy prefix and forwards the rest to https://backend.composio.dev unchanged. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <supabase JWT>, injected by the sidecar via the Composio SDK's defaultHeaders (see AgentService/src/agent.ts's makeComposio). Because the caller is the sidecar (not a browser), CORS is permissive by design here, not a security relaxation for a public client. No fixed request/response shape at the proxy level — every Composio API path forwarded through here has its own contract, owned by Composio, not Mira; out of scope to redefine here. (Deliberately no root `type`/`properties` here beyond $defs — see the equivalent note in assemblyai-proxy.schema.json.)
